name: docx_read
description: Read a Word .docx file and return its paragraphs (with style names) and tables in document order, plus the plain text. Headers, footers, comments and images are not read.

blocks.description: [{type: paragraph, style, text} | {type: table, rows}] in order

text.description: the document as plain text, table rows joined with ' | '

edge_cases: not a docx or corrupt zip
